reports.title: Chord Energy Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results, Declares Base Dividend, and Updates 2026 Outlook

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook Update
section: Chord is updating its 2026 guidance to reflect 3Q26 performance and its latest forecasts, which assumes the Marcellus divestiture closes mid-4Q26. In 2026, Chord expects to generate approximately $3.4B of Adjusted EBITDA and $1.6B of Adjusted Free Cash Flow, including the impact of derivatives ($90/Bbl WTI and $3.00/MMBtu Henry Hub for 4Q26).
